meta.title: 好莱坞钟爱台灯，因为靠它作弊？
meta.title_en: Why Hollywood Loves Table Lamps—Because They Cheat With Them?

scenes.title_cn: 开场：一个、两个、三个、四个、五个、…
scenes.title_en: Opening: one, two, three, four, five, six,…
scenes.context: 台灯是实景光源，布光作弊技巧。
sentences: 一个房间里真的需要这么多台灯吗？
Does a room really need this many lamps?
so many lamps（太多台灯）
台灯可以作为一个移动可控的光源，并且能合理出现在画面里，被称作实景光源。
A lamp is a movable, controllable source that fits in frame—the practical light.
practical light（实景光源）
什么地方缺光就放一盏台灯，给该区域的物件和人物补光。
Wherever light is missing, place a lamp to fill objects and people.
fill the light（补光）
scenes.speak: Does a room really need this many lamps? A lamp is a movable, controllable source that fits in frame—the practical light. Wherever light is missing, place a lamp to fill objects and people.

scenes.title_cn: 库布里克的蜡烛：而斯坦利·库布里克把…
scenes.context: 库布里克用特制蜡烛开创烛光拍摄。
sentences: 在电影《Barry Lyndon》室内晚宴的场景里，拒绝放置人造光源，仅靠蜡烛作为主光。
In Barry Lyndon, he refused artificial lights, using candles as key.
candle key light（蜡烛主光）
库布里克定做了特种蜡烛，烛芯是一般蜡烛的三倍，导致燃烧速度也是三倍。
Kubrick ordered special candles with triple wicks, burning three times faster.
triple wick（三倍烛芯）
合理解释光从哪来，才是台灯的杀手锏。
Explaining where the light comes from is the lamp's killer feature.
explain the light（解释光从哪来）
scenes.speak: In Barry Lyndon, he refused artificial lights, using candles as key. Kubrick ordered special candles with triple wicks, burning three times faster. Explaining where the light comes from is the lamp's killer feature.

scenes.title_cn: 逻辑光源：我们都熟知三点式布光，它被…
scenes.title_en: Logical light: we all know three-point lig…
scenes.context: 逻辑光源让轮廓光变合理。
sentences: 可惜轮廓光作为唯一的选择光源，没能解释清楚来源，导致的结果就显得没那么自然。
The rim light has no explained source, so the result looks unnatural.
unnatural rim（不自然的轮廓光）
如果我们加入一盏台灯，这道轮廓光立马就合理了。
Add a table lamp and the rim light instantly becomes logical.
logical light（逻辑光源）
其实也可以换成油烟机的灯，不影响它发挥作用。
A range-hood light works just as well.
range-hood light（油烟机灯）
scenes.speak: The rim light has no explained source, so the result looks unnatural. Add a table lamp and the rim light instantly becomes logical. A range-hood light works just as well.

scenes.title_cn: 完整光位分析：我们再来看一次场景的完…
scenes.title_en: Full light plot analysis: let's look at th…
scenes.context: 光位图里逻辑光源让布光成立。
sentences: 逻辑光甚至不必是一个自发光源，它可以是被照亮的任何东西。
A logical light needn't self-emit—it can be anything lit.
anything lit（被照亮的东西）
从窗外打到窗帘上的光其实也是一道逻辑光，因为它同样不参与演员面部的照明。
Window light on the curtain is logical light—it doesn't light the face.
curtain light（窗帘光）
这整个区域很关键，必须以被暖色的光照亮，才能暗示画外还有一盏或者多盏光源。
This region must be lit warm to imply off-screen sources.
imply sources（暗示光源）
scenes.speak: A logical light needn't self-emit—it can be anything lit. Window light on the curtain is logical light—it doesn't light the face. This region must be lit warm to imply off-screen sources.

scenes.title_cn: 台灯高度与补光灯：由于电影是动态连续…
scenes.title_en: Lamp height and practical bulbs: film is c…
scenes.context: 台灯高度适中，配合专用灯泡可精细调光。
sentences: 真正让台灯大放一彩的原因，是它的高度正好落在房间布光不高不低的中间位置。
Lamps shine because their height sits in the comfortable middle of room lighting.
middle height（中间高度）
无论拍摄机位怎么变动，都可以方便快捷地为演员重新补上面光、辅光和轮廓光。
No matter how the camera moves, you can quickly re-light face, fill, and rim.
re-light fast（快速补光）
逻辑光源需要出现在画面里，所以它们是很容易过曝的，亮度调节的挡位需要非常精细。
Logical sources appear in frame, so they blow out easily—fine brightness control needed.
easily blow out（容易过曝）
scenes.speak: Lamps shine because their height sits in the comfortable middle of room lighting. No matter how the camera moves, you can quickly re-light face, fill, and rim. Logical sources appear in frame, so they blow out easily—fine brightness control needed.

scenes.title_cn: 其他形态的逻辑光源：当然电影里平视的…
scenes.title_en: Other forms of logical light: of course, e…
scenes.context: 其他形态逻辑光源承担同样使命。
sentences: 万一有个仰视和俯视的构图，或者台灯完全不适用的时代背景，那就需要设计其他形态的逻辑光源。
For high/low angles or period settings, design other forms of logical light.
other forms（其他形态）
种种效果能让画面有层次外，但逻辑光源更是它们不可或缺的使命。
All add depth—but being logical light is their indispensable mission.
indispensable mission（不可或缺的使命）
scenes.speak: For high/low angles or period settings, design other forms of logical light. All add depth—but being logical light is their indispensable mission.

practice: A lamp is a movable, controllable practical light.
Barry Lyndon used special candles as the key light.
Adding an explained source makes rim light logical.
Logical light can be anything lit, not just a lamp.
Lamps sit at the ideal middle height for re-lighting.
pitfalls: Add a logical source to justify it.
Anything lit can serve as logical light.
Tie lighting to one lamp type.
Range hoods and other sources work too.
They need very fine brightness control.
逻辑光源易过曝要精细调。
shifts: 用 practical light（实景光源）、logical light（逻辑光源）、fill the light（补光）
用 three-point lighting（三点布光）、rim light（轮廓光）、light-dark sandwich（三明治布光）
用 point of interest（兴趣点）、information drop（信息量）、visual depth（画面层次）
